capability.name: Integraciones · Bootstrap de inventario Epicor
intents: probar conexion Epicor y detectar version soportada
mapear planta warehouse y bin de Epicor con sucursal bodega y ubicacion UBP
obtener inventario de Epicor para bootstrap manual
crear candidato de item faltante antes de aplicar existencia
consultar estado errores y resultado del bootstrap de inventario

dependencies: config tenant read and write capabilities
inventory item branch warehouse bin and movement authority
auditable idempotency key and external coordinate
restrictions: connection mapping run and result are tenant-scoped
credentials and tokens never appear in reads logs or audit payloads
provider adapters never write UBP domain databases
inventory creates items and append-only movements through canonical use cases
Epicor version behavior remains isolated behind adapters
BAQ direct SQL table access and screen scraping are not generic fallbacks
capability publication does not activate any tenant or assert runtime support

deterministic: resolve whether the tenant is entitled to configure or execute the integration
resolve provider and supported adapter version
explain bootstrap status by tenant connection run and row
identify the owning UBP domain for each canonical command
poDecision: bootstrap direction and system of record
rollout from manual bootstrap to continuous synchronization
architectHandoff: connector service boundary and canonical contracts
idempotency checkpoint retry and conflict semantics
new adapter mechanism or provider version
reviewerGate: no direct writes to domain databases
no customer fork or provider logic in core domains
forbiddenWithoutApproval: activate integration capability for a tenant
add a provider or supported version

retrieval.provenance: Published from accepted ADR-0093 scope on 2026-09-16. Existing Control Plane and Inventory anchors prove governance and domain ownership only; they do not prove an Epicor connector, adapter, connection, mapping or bootstrap runtime.
